        "Prescribe a 1 mm-deep solid pad immediately beneath the loaded segment."

      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Fig. 8(a), blue region labeled 'Solid domain (force applied)'; Sec. 4.1.1 gives no loading-pad dimensions."

      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 4.1.1 reports 160 budgets between 0.25 and 0.50 and five representatives per minimum-size setting; Fig. 8(b) does not label their individual budgets."

      "readings": [
        "Constrain total material, including passive solids, divided by the full rectangular domain area to V0.",
        "Constrain material in the green design region divided by that region's area to V0; add passive solids outside this budget."

      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 3.2 and Eqs. (22), (33) specify a global volume limit without its accounting formula; Fig. 8(a) distinguishes solid regions from the green design domain."
